summary: Explore caregiver training in ADL support, safe observation, infection prevention and SBAR handovers. Review the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Caregiver training prepares new and practising caregivers to provide safe, respectful daily support and document changes that may affect care. Participants practise assessing activities of daily living, supporting hygiene, meals and safe mobility, and applying hand-hygiene steps. They also learn to record factual observations, prepare concise SBAR handovers, and escalate changes or medication-record concerns to the responsible professional within caregiver role boundaries.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who provide or coordinate daily personal support and need dependable methods for safe care, observation and handover.
modules: Care Plan Review and Family Handover
